title: CSA – IISc Bangalore
description: CSA offers two research programs, Ph.D. and MTech (Research), and two course-based MTech programs. (Engg.) and M.E programs have been renamed M.Tech (Research) and M.Tech respectively effective academic year 2016-17. The duration of the Ph.D. program is usually 4-5 years. 2. Selection of courses: The courses you select depend on your intended area of research. should gain at least 24 credits (which may mean usually 6-8 courses) to complete their Research Training Programme (RTP) whereas a Ph.D. student who already has a Masters degree needs to gain only 12 credits (i.e. 3-4 courses). Students are usually advised to take a maximum of 4 courses in the first semester. 3. Start doing a literature survey in your area of research. You may appear for the comprehensive examination either in the third semester or in the fourth semester (before the end of two years), depending on the progress in your research work and in consultation with your advisor.
